# logos_nogo_distribution.txt: installed prebuilt logos-nogo helper distribution proof.
#
# Uses the installed prebuilt helper pkg tool (pkg/tool/GOOS_GOARCH/logos-nogo
# plus the logos-nogo.digest sidecar, logos-nogo.exe.digest on windows) with fresh GOCACHE/GOMODCACHE and
# GOPROXY=off. A logos lint finding of nogo::sa4000 over a Go package proves
# the full helper analyzer registry ran (complete analysis), not the native
# compiler-lint fallback (native rules never emit nogo::). The sidecar
# manifest is validated against a fresh recompute, including the module-zip
# go.mod -> _go.mod rename normalization. A source change is shown to
# invalidate the prebuilt/cache: the fake-GOROOT rerun either rebuilds (deps
# available) or fails with a clear missing-dependency bootstrap error, never
# stale analysis or clean.
#
# Never mutates the real GOROOT: the fake GOROOT below follows the existing
# test-script GOROOT technique (tool_build_as_needed.txt, list_goroot_symlink.txt):
# symlink the expensive trees (src, pkg/include, pkg/tool, bin/go) and copy
# only cheap helper files/data. No helper output is mocked and no assertions
# are made on helper source text; every check runs the real binary/lint.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOSUMDB=off
env GOWORK=off
env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache
env GOMODCACHE=$WORK/modcache
env TOOLDIR=$GOROOT/pkg/tool/${GOOS}_${GOARCH}

# Installed prebuilt helper plus digest sidecar (contract:
# pkg/tool/<GOOS>_<GOARCH>/logos-nogo, sidecar logos-nogo.digest,
# logos-nogo.exe.digest on windows, with a single lowercase hex sha256
# plus trailing newline).
exists $TOOLDIR/logos-nogo$GOEXE
exists $TOOLDIR/logos-nogo$GOEXE.digest

# Real tool identity (-V=full carries the executable content hash) and the
# deterministic analyzer census includes the staticcheck SA4000 analyzer.
exec $TOOLDIR/logos-nogo$GOEXE -V=full
stdout 'buildID='
exec $TOOLDIR/logos-nogo$GOEXE -list
stdout 'SA4000'

# Fresh offline lint: with empty caches and no network, the prebuilt helper
# must still drive a complete analysis. SA4000 (identical expressions on both
# sides, `x == x`) is a helper-only finding; the absence of any bootstrap
# offline error proves the prebuilt path was used, not a source rebuild.
cd sa4000
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'nogo::sa4000'
! stderr 'missing modules|offline build|one-time fetch'
cd ..

# Manifest validation: a fresh recompute over the installed helper sources
# must match the shipped sidecar exactly.
exec $TOOLDIR/logos-nogo$GOEXE -source-hash $GOROOT/lib/logos-nogo
cp stdout $WORK/hash.txt
cmp $WORK/hash.txt $TOOLDIR/logos-nogo$GOEXE.digest

# Module-zip normalization: dist renames every go.mod to _go.mod in the
# module zip, so the digest normalizes _go.mod back to go.mod. Prove it on a
# cheap two-file root (no GOROOT copy needed).
mkdir $WORK/hashnorm
cp $GOROOT/lib/logos-nogo/go.mod $WORK/hashnorm/go.mod
cp $GOROOT/lib/logos-nogo/go.sum $WORK/hashnorm/go.sum
exec $TOOLDIR/logos-nogo$GOEXE -source-hash $WORK/hashnorm
cp stdout $WORK/hash1.txt
mv $WORK/hashnorm/go.mod $WORK/hashnorm/_go.mod
exec $TOOLDIR/logos-nogo$GOEXE -source-hash $WORK/hashnorm
cp stdout $WORK/hash2.txt
cmp $WORK/hash1.txt $WORK/hash2.txt

# Module-lock invalidation at the digest level: changing the lock copy
# changes the recomputed digest (same normalization root, never built).
exec $TOOLDIR/logos-nogo$GOEXE -source-hash $WORK/hashnorm
cp stdout $WORK/hashC.txt
echo '// lock probe: invalidate helper hash'
cp stdout $WORK/hashnorm/go.sum
exec $TOOLDIR/logos-nogo$GOEXE -source-hash $WORK/hashnorm
cp stdout $WORK/hashD.txt
! cmp $WORK/hashC.txt $WORK/hashD.txt

# Source-change invalidation at the digest level: copy the helper tree with
# a stdlib-only copier, add one probe file (no source-text assertions), and
# show the digest changes.
cd sa4000
go run ../copytree.go $GOROOT/lib/logos-nogo $WORK/nogocopy
cd ..
exec $TOOLDIR/logos-nogo$GOEXE -source-hash $WORK/nogocopy
cp stdout $WORK/hashA.txt
echo '// probe: invalidate helper hash'
cp stdout $WORK/nogocopy/zz_probe_invalidate.go
exec $TOOLDIR/logos-nogo$GOEXE -source-hash $WORK/nogocopy
cp stdout $WORK/hashB.txt
! cmp $WORK/hashA.txt $WORK/hashB.txt

# Runtime invalidation under a fake GOROOT (existing symlink technique: only
# symlinks plus the cheap mutated helper copy above). The prebuilt binary is
# still visible through pkg/tool but its sidecar no longer matches the
# mutated sources, so the rerun must either rebuild (deps available, SA4000
# still reported) or fail with the clear offline bootstrap error -- never a
# stale cached analysis and never clean.
[symlink] mkdir $WORK/fakegoroot $WORK/fakegoroot/bin $WORK/fakegoroot/pkg $WORK/fakegoroot/lib
[symlink] symlink $WORK/fakegoroot/src -> $GOROOT/src
[symlink] symlink $WORK/fakegoroot/pkg/include -> $GOROOT/pkg/include
[symlink] symlink $WORK/fakegoroot/pkg/tool -> $GOROOT/pkg/tool
[symlink] symlink $WORK/fakegoroot/bin/go -> $GOROOT/bin/go
[symlink] mv $WORK/nogocopy $WORK/fakegoroot/lib/logos-nogo
[symlink] env GOROOT=$WORK/fakegoroot
[symlink] env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache2
[symlink] env GOMODCACHE=$WORK/modcache2
[symlink] cd sa4000
[symlink] ! logos lint ./...
[symlink] stderr 'nogo::sa4000|missing modules|offline|one-time fetch|logos nogo bootstrap'

-- sa4000/go.mod --
module example.com/sa4000

go 1.27

-- sa4000/main.go --
package main

func same(x int) bool {
	return x == x
}

func main() {
	println(same(1))
}

-- copytree.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 3 {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "usage: copytree <src> <dst>\n")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	if err := copyTree(os.Args[1], os.Args[2]); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "copytree: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func copyTree(src, dst string) error {
	info, err := os.Stat(src)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !info.IsDir() {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s is not a directory", src)
	}
	return filepath.WalkDir(src, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		rel, err := filepath.Rel(src, path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		target := filepath.Join(dst, rel)
		if d.IsDir() {
			return os.MkdirAll(target, 0o777)
		}
		in, err := os.Open(path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		defer in.Close()
		out, err := os.OpenFile(target, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_TRUNC, 0o666)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = io.Copy(out, in)
		if err != nil {
			out.Close()
			return err
		}
		return out.Close()
	})
}
